markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 simulated frozen section suggests invasive carcinoma [F1] at all four margins [F7] with severity-3 stain degradation.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Strong invasive score; ECE 5% |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (alpha 10%, coverage 90%) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 64th OOD percentile [F6] | Passes QC; stain degradation 3 |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree (same top class) | Independent backbones match top call |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Invasive (80%) [F5]; 1 InSitu (89%) | Mostly invasive; close in-situ neighbor |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 9) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.513); 0/20 AI spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 4) · context · Below-typical score (+0.479); 8/20 AI spot check [F3] · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.378), caption inconsistent, 18/20 check [F4] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0) · ↑ invasive · Elevated score (+0.269); 19/20 AI spot check · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 11) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.219); 12/20 AI spot check · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops score vs random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); top driver `normal_lobules` (0/20), `necrosis` (3/20), `mitoses` (0/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Lesion is in-situ like neighbor `BACH_0241` (89% similarity, InSitu), supported by tubules in regions 3, 10, 11.
- Simulated frozen-section stain degradation (severity 3) distorts morphology or inflates positive calls across all four margins.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 5, 8, 9**: Verify stromal invasion in highest-risk regions (95%–100% risk) versus stain artifact.
2. **Regions 3, 10, 11**: Assess tubules and duct-confined atypia pushing against invasive carcinoma.
3. **Regions 0–4, 7–11**: Check superior (645 um), lateral (538 um), inferior (430 um), medial (215 um) margins.
